anchor_scope: atm-bd dispatch candidate filter order for sanity and qa beads
anchor_statement: atm-bd must assign a sanity or qa bead only when bd ready lists it and, checked afterwards, no ATM task with that bead id exists; a bead whose task the hook already assigned is never assigned a second time.

cases.text: atm-bd reads bd ready, then atm task list, and skips the sanity bead because its task already exists.

cases.rationale: Approved fail fixture: cached task list leads to a second assignment.
cases.text: atm-bd caches the task list from the previous tick and assigns the sanity bead a second time.
For each sanity or qa bead in the bd ready output, dispatch then queries atm task list for a task carrying that bead id and assigns the bead only if no such task exists.

cases.rationale: In-scope dispatch, silent about the filter order.
cases.text: atm-bd dispatch builds the qa-template vars file for each qa bead it assigns.

cases.rationale: The task check must come after bd ready; an earlier snapshot can miss a task the hook just assigned.
